_compact_report_provenance.hash_comparison_scope: text hashes are SHA256 of UTF8 without normalization; vector hashes use canonical JSON UTF8 without whitespace and allow_nan=False. These describe original leaves, not compact replacement files

scope: read-only raw/parsed/ITN differences on existing curve JSON; no model/NPU execution, no accuracy or WER claim
limitations: shape evidence is captured runtime metadata, not inferred from configured batch size
wall phase envelopes overlap/shared synchronization; do not sum as kernel occupancy
same outputs do not prove correctness; text differences have no winner without human labels
ITN is a separate per-segment transform, not complete v3 output simulation

itn_policy.scope: parsed segment text -> ITN only; whole-audio dominant-language selection, repetition repair and final sanitization are not simulated
